name: Each news card shows a source name and publication date
description: News cards should display both the source/publisher name (e.g., 'BBC Sport', 'ESPN', 'Reuters') and a publication date or timestamp so readers know how recent and credible the article is.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match cell to open a match detail page
Examine the first two news cards in the panel

Verify each news card shows at least one of: a source name (media outlet name), a date string (like May 2026, or 2 days ago), or a timestamp. Cards with only a title and no source or date metadata fail this test.
